parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch part of the wall switch assembly, made of ABS plastic, typically rectangular and small in size.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator that toggles the electrical circuit on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally within a small range to make or break the electrical connection.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate, forming the main structural housing.
parts.Functional_description: It provides mechanical support and insulation for the internal electrical components and the switch mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall surface, providing a stable mounting base for the switch.
